name: Easy Slow Cooker Peanut Butter-Thai Pork Curry with Mixed Veggies & Rice

ingredients.name: frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, sugar snap peas, water chestnuts)

instructions.primary_message: Place water, peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, maple syrup, minced garlic, salt, and pepper in a 6-quart slow cooker insert, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp lime juice
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tsp pure maple syrup
2 tsp minced garlic
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add pork to the slow cooker, then stir to combine. Cover and cook until pork is cooked through, 4-5 hours on LOW or HIGH for about 2 hours.
When the pork is done, add pad Thai sauce, frozen veggies, and baby corn. Stir to combine and continue to cook until veggies are tender, 1 hour more.
instructions.secondary_message:
174 ml pad thai stir-fry sauce
1 (306 g) bag frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, sugar snap peas, water chestnuts)
1 (425 g) can baby corn

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies have about 30 minutes left, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pork curry and rice between bowls. Top with peanuts and enjoy!
